name: CON: Tale of the Darkness
detailed_description:
The world is on the brink of extinction.

A deadly liquid called Darkness is spreading across the Earth, killing anyone it touches. Desperate people wander hopelessly, searching for a refuge that may not exist.

But a voice speaks of an ancient city at the edge of the world—the only place the Darkness has yet to reach.

You set out toward this legendary city, only to find that the very laws of the universe have been distorted. Nothing works as it should anymore.

You soon discover a power within yourself: the ability to shift between overlapping dimensions, allowing you to overcome impossible challenges, uncover hidden paths, and reveal forgotten worlds.

The Darkness is not just a random threat—it’s part of a deeper mystery rooted in that city. Embark on an interdimensional journey to uncover its origin, stop its spread, and maybe, just maybe, save what’s left of the world.

  • Multidimensional Exploration
    Snap your fingers to shift in real time between multiple overlapping realities—each with unique environments, paths, and secrets.

  • High-Intensity Action Platforming
    Run, jump, and sprint through dynamic platforming segments that test your reflexes and timing.

  • Environmental Puzzles
    Manipulate statues and architecture across dimensions to unlock new areas and solve intricate challenges.

  • Deep and Branching Narrative
    Piece together the world’s tragic past through collectible journals and environmental storytelling, with choices that shape your path.

  • Rising Tension
    Race against the unstoppable spread of the Darkness to uncover its origin and save the last remaining hope.

Controls and Accessibility
Full support for both controller and keyboard, with customizable key mapping, scalable text, and colorblind-friendly palettes.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains dark and mature themes, including visual representations of death, decay, and disturbing environments. Some scenes depict non-graphic violence and unsettling imagery. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. However, the tone and atmosphere may be distressing to sensitive players due to the game’s post-apocalyptic and horror-fantasy themes.
